_comment: Manual status overrides. Status is normally DERIVED from git — merged to
the integration branch = done, open PR = in review, pushed branch = in
progress. Use this file only when reality and git genuinely disagree:
work that predates the task-ID commit convention, or something half-done
Every override needs a reason. An override without one is how a plan
starts reporting what people wish were true.
Valid status values: todo | in-progress | in-review | done | blocked
